rationale: Class 3 anchor check: the source statement of assets and liabilities balances for 2025 because 26,304,427 - 13,867,596 = 12,436,831, matching total net assets. The investment schedule separately reports total investments at fair value of 25,337,420 and 203.71 as fair value as a percent of net assets, so investments exceeding NAV is disclosed leverage, not a broken NAV identity. The rule fire is therefore a false alarm from applying the identity to the wrong surface/scope.
